events.title: Samsung Internet moves to Chromium
events.summary: Samsung Internet 6.2 shipped in January 2017 on Chromium 56 — replacing the WebKit base with Blink for closer Chrome compatibility.
events.about: The Chromium switch aligned Samsung Internet with the majority of Android browsers: same DevTools quirks, extension APIs, and rendering as Chrome. It reduced web developer testing burden on Galaxy devices while keeping Samsung-specific features like content blockers.

narrative.whyChosen: Samsung Internet's Chromium migration affected hundreds of millions of Android users.
narrative.whyImportant: It consolidated mobile browsing on Blink alongside Chrome and Edge.
narrative.problemSolved: WebKit-only Samsung Internet diverged from Chrome behavior developers tested against.
